messages:
Alex: p95 jump on hosted text-gen at 12:04 UTC — from ~220ms to 1.6s for a 10m window. Noticed throughput drop on some GPU pools.
infra-bot: [ALERT] latency_spike /service/inference hosted-prod — p95 1.6s, p99 3.9s, triggered at 2025-09-18T12:04:12Z.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20250918-23 (sev2) — paging eng-runtime oncall.
Priya: Seeing a lot of kernel-selection churn in the flameprof logs around that time. Many queries flipped from fast-atten kernel to fallback conv1x on the same sequence length.
Jamal: +1. I pulled a sample trace. Large proportion of requests from tenant "hot-tenant-42" with long prompt prefixes — KV cache miss rate spiked. KV eviction rate up 4x.
Megan: Could be noisy neighbor from that tenant. They recently rolled batching_v2 and higher max_batch_size in Dedicated?
Alex: Confirmed tenant config: batching_v2 enabled + aggressive batch_autoscale. Their average concurrent sessions jumped ~3x at 12:02.
Priya: Kernel heuristics currently prefer conv1x when KV cache is cold and sequence > 512. If cache misses spike, kernel selection falls back which increases token time.
Rachel: I can flip a routing rule to steer that tenant to fewer concurrent shards (throttle) while we investigate. Proposed: soft throttle to 60% of their burst capacity.
Jamal: Do it. Also suggest flipping feature flag that enables batching_v2 for that tenant. Quick rollback is `feature-toggle set hot-tenant-42 batching_v2 false`.
Megan: On it — running the toggle now.
Megan: ```
# feature flag rollback
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"tenant":"hot-tenant-42","flag":"batching_v2","value":false}'
```
infra-bot: feature-toggle: succeeded for hot-tenant-42 (batching_v2 -> false) by Megan.
Priya: After flag flip, p95 dropped to ~330ms within 90s. KV miss rate halved. Kernel selection stabilized back to fast-atten.
Alex: Great. Still seeing occasional p99 spikes in some pods — likely cache rebuilds. Can we enable KV warmup for hot-tenant-42 on the fallback path?
Jamal: We have a quick patch: aggressive prefix caching for tenant on route fallback. I can enable it via rollout FF `kv_warmup_hotpath=true` for that tenant.
Rachel: Go ahead, but keep it scoped and monitor. Put a canary for 10% first.
Jamal: Canary on 10% now. infra-bot: rollout started: kv_warmup_hotpath -> 10% for hot-tenant-42.
Priya: Profiling after canary shows reduced context-switch overhead and fewer kernel switches. p95 ~280ms on canary.
Megan: I'll open a follow-up perf ticket to tune kernel-selection thresholds so fallback is less aggressive when eviction bursts are transient.
Alex: Also add a routing policy to prefer quantized-small models as a controlled fallback to reduce GPU pressure when these spikes happen.
Rachel: Noted. I'll coordinate with product for tenant-level quotas to prevent noisy tenant bursts (proactive).
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20250918-23 updated: mitigation applied (feature flags rolled back, kv warmup canary). Continue monitoring for 30m, then update severity.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Action items: Megan -> postmortem draft, Jamal -> rollout kernel-selection threshold patch (canary), Rachel -> tenant quota proposal, Priya -> perf dashboard with flameprof snippets.
Megan: Will do. Closing slack loop here, will update postmortem link when ready. :thumbsup:
